angular-zoneless-onpush-rules:
In zoneless Angular (provideZonelessChangeDetection) with OnPush components:

1. Template-bound state modified from addEventListener callbacks or service callbacks MUST be a signal
2. Raw DOM addEventListener does NOT trigger change detection (no zone.js to intercept)
3. Programmatic callbacks (websocket onopen, promise .then, service listeners) do NOT trigger CD
4. Only signal changes, template event bindings, and explicit markForCheck/detectChanges trigger CD
5. markForCheck() DOES work in zoneless Angular 22+ (schedules CD via ChangeDetectionScheduler)
6. For @for loops: track by a stable key (like node.svyid) not object reference when objects are recreated
7. redrawDecorators pattern: create NEW objects (spread operator) and .set() the signal - mutating existing objects in a signal array does NOT trigger notification
angular-cross-project-libraries:
When Angular projects in servoy-eclipse need to share code (sablo, designer, public), they must be pre-built as Angular libraries and consumed as tgz packages. 

Key rules:
1. NEVER use tsconfig paths pointing to source in another Angular project - causes duplicate @angular/core module instances
2. Use npm pack to create tgz, then install with file: reference to tgz (NOT to directory)
3. file: to directory causes signal INPUT_SIGNAL_BRAND_WRITE_TYPE mismatch; file: to tgz works like a real npm registry package
4. Build order: ngclient.ui libs must be built before designer.rfb npm install
5. In Maven, use ${project.basedir}/../ for relative paths to sibling modules

Build command: cd com.servoy.eclipse.ngclient.ui/node && npm run build_libs
This builds @servoy/public, @servoy/sablo, @servoy/designer and packs them as tgz files.
